as_told.title: Medvedev's April Fool's remark about UFOs and nuclear codes

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of an interview with Dmitry Medvedev, a senior Russian political leader, that took place on April Fool's Day. According to Michels, the interviewer asked about UFOs expecting a joke, and Medvedev answered that Russia keeps an extensive file on the subject. If he meant it, it would suggest the Russian government takes the topic seriously behind closed doors.
